author: joshgshh
quote: I have played every single GTA game ever made and these people will actually think they made a worthy GTA game just from the revenue of the preorder sales and legacy of the series.... I can't express enough how disappointing this downfall is for the next generation. This series was built on freedom and being in a 'green lantern' sandbox where your imagination defines the experience. It has also lost its Southpark style where everything is fair game no matter who you are; to now selectively enforcing various mandatory protected communities who are already disproportionately empowered IRL (statistically). As a man who remembers the childlike freedom wonder and fun of the old games to the new cookie-cutter bland corporate woke ai slop of this release is really unfortunate. However, it's not all doomer we just have to wait until the PC community mods and remasters this game for how it was meant to be played in roughly the next 2 weeks. Censors and suppressants of the first amendment are everywhere; the last place we need it is where we go to relax. I hate to be that guy but please ~ Make GTA Great Again ~.
